name: Pine Cone Crunch
tagline: The one the eyewitnesses can't stop talking about.
description: Toasted oat clusters with pine nuts, maple and a pinch of sea salt, pressed into cone-shaped bites that survive the bottom of any pack.
imageAlt: A pile of golden, cone-shaped oat clusters on a mossy log

name: Huckleberry Hustle
tagline: Tart berries for the last mile.
description: Chewy huckleberry and apple fruit leather, rolled and tied with a strip of parchment so it doesn't stick to your fingers on the climb.
imageAlt: Purple fruit leather rolls tied with parchment on a granite rock

name: Summit S'mores
description: Graham cracker squares sandwiching dark chocolate and a toasted marshmallow layer that stays put up to 9,000 feet.
imageAlt: Stacked s'mores squares beside a tin camp mug

name: Moss Mix
description: Roasted pumpkin seeds, pistachios and dried edamame tossed in seaweed and lime. It looks like the forest floor and tastes better.
imageAlt: A green trail mix of seeds and pistachios in a wooden bowl

name: Bigfoot Jerky
description: Smoky mushroom and soy jerky strips, cut long enough that you'll wonder who they were sized for.
imageAlt: Long strips of dark mushroom jerky on butcher paper

name: Trailhead Toffee
tagline: A small reward for leaving the car.
description: Brittle almond toffee broken into thumb-sized shards and dusted with cocoa. Best eaten while reading the trail map.
imageAlt: Shards of amber almond toffee on a folded trail map
